Does not add plugin_github_languages_hide_pct or any plugin_<plugin>_<widget>_<option> Action input

evals.prompt: Add a widget with CSS animation for gif and apng output.
evals.expected_output: Copies keyframes.css.template as animation.css. CSS @keyframes are authoring input to renderAnimation via @profile-bits/renderer (takumi-js 2.9.2). Formats allow-list includes gif and apng. APNG files are named .png. Default SVG remains a baked still with no <style>, @keyframes, SMIL, or foreignObject in renderSvg() output. Card 480×160 on the existing github pack.
assertions: Copies assets/templates/keyframes.css.template into the widget dir (animation.css)
Treats CSS @keyframes as authoring input to render / renderAnimation, not GitHub SVG runtime
Includes gif and apng on the formats allow-list with default format svg
Names APNG output with a .png extension
Keeps default SVG as a baked still (no <style>, @keyframes, SMIL, or foreignObject in renderSvg output)
Renders through @profile-bits/renderer only (no direct takumi-js / @takumi-rs/* import in the widget)
Uses card size 480×160 and root width/height 100%
Does not create a new pack or new integration just to add animation

evals.prompt: Drop in a widget.mdx file with no source field.

Pipeline is @mdx-js/mdx → fromJsx. Sets md.presets / md.families for md/mdx. Ambiguous dual canonical files without source would fail.
assertions: Copies assets/templates/widget.mdx.template as widget.mdx
Omits the source field (prefer omit when the file is named correctly)
Relies on discoverSource extension .mdx → mdx (no explicit source override)
Does not emit a second canonical widget.md or widget.tsx in the same dir
Maps MDX components to bits (Theme, Frame, Stack, Row, Text, Muted, Stat, Bar, Chip, Avatar, Divider)
Uses remark/rehype via @mdx-js/mdx then fromJsx (not remark-mdx + remark-html)
Declares md.presets and md.families for the md/mdx widget
Would fail closed on ambiguous widget.md + widget.tsx without source
